description.default: The maximum number of SharePoint error event items to process in a single run of the PPMF-Sync-SharePointErrorsToDataverse flow. Limits the volume of Dataverse write operations per sync cycle to prevent throttling and runaway execution costs. Increase if the sync consistently has a large backlog; decrease if Dataverse or SharePoint throttle errors appear in the sync flow run history. Default: 100.
